linesZhTw: 在北方，更遠的地方好像是
linesZhCn: 在北方，更远的地方好像是
linesEn: I spot the orc army to the north.
Further out, it looks like a detachment of catfolk warriors.
Speaking of catfolk, that reminds me of my senior disciple brother, Sekobang...
Wait! Isn't that him right over there?!
Brother Sekobang! Is that you?
It's me, Carrie!
Who calls my name?

linesZhTw: 怎麼會在這時候遇上妳…』
linesZhCn: 怎么会在这时候遇上你…』
linesEn: Carrie?! What a surprise!
What in the world brings you here at a time like this...?

linesZhTw: 『我聽說獸人大軍攻打豹人族
就帶朋友們來幫忙，也沒預
想到會在這裡遇到師兄你…
linesZhCn: 『我听说兽人大军攻打豹人族
就带朋友们来帮忙，也没预
想到会在这里遇到师兄你…
linesEn: I heard the orc army was marching against the catfolk,
so I brought my friends to lend a hand.
Never imagined I'd actually run into you here, Brother!

linesZhTw: 還有，這批獸人是由其首領
薩卡所帶領，你們要特別小
linesZhCn: 还有，这批兽人是由其首领
萨卡所带领，你们要特别小
linesEn: If that's the case, you have my gratitude!
Be warned: this horde is led by their chieftain, Zaka.
You must exercise extreme caution!
Understood!

linesZhTw: 個忙好嗎？我一個人是打不
linesZhCn: 个忙好吗？我一个人是打不
linesEn: Thor, Ares, everyone—please lend me a hand!
I'll never take down this orc army on my own...

linesZhTw: 幫豹人的，索爾，你說是不
linesZhCn: 帮豹人的，索尔，你说是不
linesEn: Don't worry, aiding the catfolk was our plan all along.
Right, Thor?

linesZhTw: 的嗎？眼前就有一大堆欠湊
的傢伙，還囉唆什麼？我們
linesZhCn: 的吗？眼前就有一大堆欠凑
的家伙，还啰唆什么？我们
linesEn: You bet! We came here for a fight, didn't we?
There's a whole mob begging for a beating, so why waste breath talking?
Let's move out!
Thank you, everyone!
Hmph, more nuisances meddling in my way?
Die, all of you! Slaughter every last one!

linesZhTw: 在北方，更遠的地方好像是
linesZhCn: 在北方，更远的地方好像是
linesEn: I spot the orc army to the north.
Further out, it looks like a detachment of catfolk warriors.
The catfolk look hard-pressed.
Let us make haste and lend them our aid!
Hey! Hang in there, catfolk friends!
Reinforcements have arrived!
Who goes there?
Enemy reinforcements?!

linesZhTw: 此地戰況險惡，你們來這裡
幹什麼？不想受傷就快走吧
linesZhCn: 此地战况险恶，你们来这里
干什么？不想受伤就快走吧
linesEn: Wait... just a bunch of youngsters?!
This battlefield is perilous! What are you doing here?
Flee at once if you value your lives!

linesZhTw: 我們是來幫你們的，這些雜
linesZhCn: 我们是来帮你们的，这些杂
linesEn: You're a good sort, mister! Relax, we're on your side.
Leave these scumbags to us—we'll handle them!

linesZhTw: 樣子…好吧，我在此先謝謝
你們！此外，這批獸人是由
linesZhCn: 样子…好吧，我在此先谢谢
你们！此外，这批兽人是由
linesEn: Is that so? You certainly don't lack confidence...
Very well, you have my sincere thanks!

linesZhTw: 其首領薩卡所帶領，你們要
linesZhCn: 其首领萨卡所带领，你们要
linesEn: Beware: these orcs are led by their chieftain, Zaka.
You must exercise extreme caution!
Got it! All right everyone, let's get 'em!
Hmph, more nuisances meddling in my way?
Die, all of you! Slaughter every last one!
There's nowhere left to retreat!
Fight to the end, brothers!
Master...
Forgive me...
You can't even finish off this pathetic handful?!
Second squad, forward!
Aaargh... Master, save me...
You promised me... promised me power and...
...eternal... life... Urgh...

linesZhTw: 等一下沒人可以問話了，
linesZhCn: 等一下没人可以问话了，
linesEn: Oops, hit him a little too hard.
Now there's no one left to interrogate. What a shame.
Blast it, looks like we're late!

linesZhTw: 『首領命令我們攜帶這批貴重
寶物，為了避免引起注意所
以繞道而行，遲到也是應該
linesZhCn: 『首领命令我们携带这批贵重
宝物，为了避免引起注意所
以绕道而行，迟到也是应该
linesEn: The chieftain ordered us to transport these precious treasures.
We took a detour to avoid drawing attention, so of course it took longer.
Can't be helped!
Wonder how the battle is going up ahead?
Hey! Weren't you lot tasked with hauling the treasures?
What are you doing here?
The chieftain ordered us to bring the goods here and rendezvous with him...

linesZhTw: 趕快離開這裡，把東西帶到
linesZhCn: 赶快离开这里，把东西带到
linesEn: You fool! Can't you see the battle's turning against us?!
Get out of here and take the goods to the Isle of Ice!
U-Understood!
Run for your lives!

linesZhTw: 寶石嗎？為何獸人族也在收
linesZhCn: 宝石吗？为何兽人族也在收
linesEn: Wait... Isn't this the Eye of Light gem?!
Why would orcs be gathering relics like this...?

linesZhTw: 我聽老師說過，聽說它們有
強大的魔力，但這和獸人族
linesZhCn: 我听老师说过，听说它们有
强大的魔力，但这和兽人族
linesEn: The legendary Evil Eye gems?
My master once spoke of them—they hold immense magical power.
But what could the orcs possibly want with them...?

linesZhTw: 值並不只是魔力而已，而是
和一件古代的秘密有很大的
linesZhCn: 值并不只是魔力而已，而是
和一件古代的秘密有很大的
linesEn: You know of them as well? Their true significance goes far beyond mere magic.
Supposedly, they are tied to a profound secret from ancient times...
What are you two whispering about?
Sounds like something interesting!
Save the chatter for later.
Let's finish this battle first!

linesZhTw: 夠抵擋獸人軍的攻勢，我們
代表豹人族向各位致上十二
linesZhCn: 够抵挡兽人军的攻势，我们
代表豹人族向各位致上十二
linesEn: Thanks to your aid, we were able to withstand the orc assault.
On behalf of the catfolk, I offer you our deepest gratitude.

linesZhTw: 些朋友們都是正義的熱血好
漢，他們一路上已經不知道
linesZhCn: 些朋友们都是正义的热血好
汉，他们一路上已经不知道
linesEn: No need to be so formal, Brother!
My friends here are all valiant champions of justice.
They've already helped countless people on our journey.

linesZhTw: 有看到獸人的軍隊在其他地
linesZhCn: 有看到兽人的军队在其他地
linesEn: Be that as it may, I must still express my thanks.
By the way, Carrie, have you seen orc forces appearing elsewhere?

linesZhTw: 的都城哈斯米爾，然後又和
我們在蘭迪平原打了一仗，
linesZhCn: 的都城哈斯米尔，然后又和
我们在兰迪平原打了一仗，
linesEn: We certainly have! First they besieged the elven capital, Hasmir,
and then we clashed with them across the Randy Plains.

linesZhTw: 最近獸人都看得都厭了。』
linesZhCn: 最近兽人都看得都厌了。』
linesEn: Honestly, I'm sick to death of seeing orcs lately.
Is that true? Then the rumors of a conspiracy are genuine.
What do you mean?

linesZhTw: 背後操縱黑森林一帶的獸人
族和狂戰士，準備要對精靈
linesZhCn: 背后操纵黑森林一带的兽人
族和狂战士，准备要对精灵
linesEn: Word reached me recently that someone is pulling strings from the shadows,
controlling the orcs and berserkers near the Black Forest.

linesZhTw: 族和豹人族進行滅族的屠戮
行動，我起初還半信半疑，
兼程趕回家鄉看看，沒想到
linesZhCn: 族和豹人族进行灭族的屠戮
行动，我起初还半信半疑，
兼程赶回家乡看看，没想到
linesEn: Their plan was a systematic slaughter to exterminate both elves and catfolk.
I was skeptical at first, but rushed back to check on my homeland...
...only to walk right into this battle.

linesZhTw: 『我們精靈族也差點慘遭屠戮
到底是誰在背後操縱這一切
linesZhCn: 『我们精灵族也差点惨遭屠戮
到底是谁在背后操纵这一切
linesEn: Our elven kin came perilously close to annihilation as well.
Just who is pulling the strings behind all this?

linesZhTw: 朋友所言，有更大群的獸人
和黑暗戰士在北方的冰島一
linesZhCn: 朋友所言，有更大群的兽人
和黑暗战士在北方的冰岛一
linesEn: I do not know for certain. However, according to a friend of mine,
an even larger horde of orcs and dark warriors is gathering in the northern ice lands.

linesZhTw: 帶集結，她已經先前去調查
了，我預計在解決這裡的事
情之後，也會儘快趕去和她
linesZhCn: 带集结，她已经先前去调查
了，我预计在解决这里的事
情之后，也会尽快赶去和她
linesEn: She went ahead to investigate. Once things were settled here,
I planned to rendezvous with her as swiftly as possible.
That was my original plan.

linesZhTw: 向而去，看來這些事情似乎
linesZhCn: 向而去，看来这些事情似乎
linesEn: Jonah appeared to be heading in that direction as well.
It seems these events are all intertwined...
Since our paths align, why don't we travel together?
Sounds like a plan! I'm itching to see who's behind all this mischief!
Let's move!

linesZhTw: 夠抵擋獸人軍的攻勢，我們
代表豹人族向各位致上十二
linesZhCn: 够抵挡兽人军的攻势，我们
代表豹人族向各位致上十二
linesEn: Thanks to your aid, we were able to withstand the orc assault.
On behalf of the catfolk, I offer you our deepest gratitude.
Think nothing of it!
Besides, it gave us a good chance to stretch our muscles.

linesZhTw: 謝你們。對了，各位可有看
到獸人的軍隊在其他地方出
linesZhCn: 谢你们。对了，各位可有看
到兽人的军队在其他地方出
linesEn: Be that as it may, I must still express my thanks.
Tell me, have any of you encountered orc forces elsewhere?

linesZhTw: 靈族族的都城哈斯米爾，然
後又和我們在蘭迪平原打了
linesZhCn: 灵族族的都城哈斯米尔，然
后又和我们在兰迪平原打了
linesEn: Indeed! First they attacked Hasmir, capital of our elven people,
and then clashed with us across the Randy Plains.

linesZhTw: 一仗，最近獸人真是囂張得
linesZhCn: 一仗，最近兽人真是嚣张得
linesEn: Lately, these orcs have grown outrageously brazen.
Is that true? Then the rumors of a conspiracy are genuine.
What do you mean?
